verdict.rationale: AMD docs confirm MXFP4/MXFP6 low-precision datatype support and inference serving via vLLM and SGLang, and community benchmarks (Chips and Cheese, HN) corroborate real matrix/inference throughput comparisons on the part. However, explicit FP8 support, TensorRT-LLM, and llama.cpp integration are not documented anywhere in the evidence pack, leaving a meaningful gap in the story's full serving-stack breadth. missing for 10: explicit FP8 precision docs, TensorRT-LLM support, llama.cpp support/benchmarks.
